caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden altar structure with ornate details. The main body of the altar is predominantly white, with blue accents along the base, top edge, and vertical side columns. The sides feature turned spindle columns, also painted white with gold embellishments. The base of the altar has corner supports with blue bands and small, black spherical feet. The upper section of the altar has a triangular pediment with gold decorative elements, including a gold cross at the center, two stylized birds facing the cross, and floral motifs. On either side of the pediment, there are two finials with wooden spindle tops and gray diagonal rods projecting outwards. The entire composition is presented against a plain, beige background.
title: Shrine
